repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: REA 是基于 MCP 协议的逆向工程智能体框架，支持原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集及网页的多平台分析。通过对接 Hopper、Ghidra、IDA 等专业工具，让 AI 智能体在本地完成代码审查与行为逆向，输出带证据链的结论，适用于竞品分析与安全研究。
repos.summary_en: REA is an MCP-based reverse engineering agent framework supporting multi-platform analysis of native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites. It connects to Hopper, Ghidra, and IDA for local code inspection and behavioral reverse engineering with evidence-backed conclusions, ideal for competitive analysis and security research.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: ECC 是一个 AI 智能体性能优化系统，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等 AI 编程助手设计。系统提供技能管理、内存优化、安全扫描和研究优先开发框架，支持跨 harness 架构。从 Anthropic hackathon 胜出，经过 10+ 个月实战验证，支持 12+ 语言生态，可显著提升 AI 编程效率和质量。
repos.summary_en: ECC is a production-ready AI agent harness performance optimization system designed for Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants. It provides comprehensive capabilities including skills management, instincts, memory optimization, continuous learning, security scanning, and research-first development framework. Winner of Anthropic hackathon, battle-tested over 10+ months across 12+ language ecosystems with cross-harness architecture, dramatically improving AI coding efficiency and code quality.

repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
repos.summary_zh: RuView利用商用WiFi的CSI信道状态信息，通过物理信号处理和机器学习实现穿墙人体感知。系统提供实时姿态估计(54K fps)、呼吸心率监测及毫秒级存在检测，无需摄像头或穿戴设备。基于Rust构建，支持ESP32-S3等低成本硬件，适用于智能安防、健康监护及灾难救援等隐私敏感场景。
repos.summary_en: RuView transforms commodity WiFi CSI signals into real-time human perception through physics-based signal processing and ML. It delivers 54K fps pose estimation, vital sign monitoring (breathing/heartbeat), and <1ms presence detection without cameras or wearables. Built in Rust with 1100+ tests, it supports ESP32-S3 and research NICs for through-wall sensing up to 5m. Ideal for privacy-preserving smart home, healthcare, security, and disaster response applications.

repos.description: Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.
repos.summary_zh: Strix 是一款开源的 AI 安全代理工具，通过模拟真实黑客行为动态扫描应用漏洞。核心亮点包括：团队协作模式实现高效漏洞挖掘、生成可验证的 PoC 而非误报、提供一键自动修复方案，并支持 CI/CD 集成。适用于快速渗透测试、Bug 赏金自动化和应用安全测试，大幅提升安全测试效率。
repos.summary_en: Strix is an open-source AI-powered security agent that simulates real hackers to dynamically discover and validate application vulnerabilities. Key features include: collaborative agent teams for efficient scanning, real PoC generation eliminating false positives, one-click autofix capabilities, and seamless CI/CD integration. Ideal for rapid penetration testing, bug bounty automation, and application security testing, dramatically accelerating security remediation.

repos.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
repos.summary_zh: 该技能将编码代理转化为安全审计员，通过侦察、覆盖驱动狩猎、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录验证和中性报告六阶段，生成机器可读且经独立验证的安全发现，适用于代码库安全审计与漏洞挖掘。
repos.summary_en: This skill turns a coding agent into a security auditor, orchestrating six phases—reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting—to produce machine-readable, independently verified findings for codebase security audits and vulnerability discovery.

repos.description: 《动手学大模型Dive into LLMs》系列编程实践教程
repos.summary_zh: 本教程源自上海交大课程，提供大模型全栈实践指南。涵盖微调部署、提示工程、知识编辑、数学推理、模型水印、越狱攻击等前沿主题。每个章节配套Jupyter Notebook脚本与课件，支持华为昇腾国产化平台。适合高校教学、学术研究与工业实践，助力快速掌握大模型开发与安全攻防技术。
repos.summary_en: This hands-on tutorial series, derived from Shanghai Jiao Tong University courses, offers comprehensive LLMs practical guidance. Covering fine-tuning, prompting, knowledge editing, math reasoning, model watermarking, and jailbreak attacks. Each chapter includes Jupyter notebooks and slides, supporting Huawei Ascend platform. Ideal for academic teaching, research, and industrial practice in LLM development and security.

repos.description: Run macOS VM in a Docker! Run near native OSX-KVM in Docker! X11 Forwarding! CI/CD for OS X Security Research! Docker mac Containers.
repos.summary_zh: Docker-OSX通过KVM和OpenCore技术实现在Docker容器中运行接近原生性能的macOS虚拟机。支持X11图形转发和iPhone USB设备穿透，专为macOS安全研究（如iMessage漏洞分析）和自动化CI/CD流程设计，提供便携且隔离的测试环境，显著提升安全研究员的工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Docker-OSX leverages KVM and OpenCore to run near-native macOS virtual machines inside Docker containers. It features X11 GUI forwarding and iPhone USB passthrough, specifically designed for macOS security research (including iMessage analysis) and CI/CD automation. This solution provides security researchers with a portable, isolated, and reproducible testing environment for efficient vulnerability discovery.

repos.description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base  Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Claude Code / Kiro / Cursor / Cline 等代码 AI 客户端
repos.summary_zh: reverse-skill 是一个面向 AI 编码客户端的逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究技能路由包。它通过 AI 驱动的路由矩阵与 RULES.md，自动将 APK、二进制、JS 加密、CTF、固件等任务导向正确方法论和工具链。核心亮点包括按需自举工具链、自进化知识库，以及与 IDA Pro、Ghidra、Frida 等集成，避免盲目猜命令，实现经验复用。支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等客户端，多平台部署，显著提升安全研究效率。
repos.summary_en: reverse-skill is an AI-powered skill router pack for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research, designed for AI coding clients like Claude Code and Cursor. It automatically routes tasks involving APKs, binaries, JS encryption, CTF, and firmware to the correct methodologies and tools via a routing matrix and RULES.md. Highlights include on-demand toolchain bootstrapping, a self-evolving knowledge base, and integration with IDA Pro, Ghidra, and Frida. It prevents blind command guessing, enables experience reuse, and supports cross-platform deployments for efficient security workflows.

repos.description: Nuclei is a fast, customizable vulnerability scanner powered by the global security community and built on a simple YAML-based DSL, enabling collaboration to tackle trending vulnerabilities on the internet. It helps you find vulnerabilities in your applications, APIs, networks, DNS, and cloud configurations.
repos.summary_zh: Nuclei是基于YAML模板的高性能漏洞扫描器，由全球安全社区驱动。支持自定义真实场景检测，覆盖应用、API、网络、DNS及云配置，通过模拟步骤实现零误报，超快并行扫描并易于集成CI/CD，快速应对新兴漏洞。
repos.summary_en: Nuclei is a high-performance vulnerability scanner powered by YAML templates and the global security community. It enables custom real-world detection with zero false positives, supports multi-protocol scanning of apps, APIs, networks, DNS and cloud configs, and integrates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines.

repos.description: An evolving how-to guide for securing a Linux server.
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库提供全面的 Linux 服务器安全加固实践指南，涵盖 SSH 密钥与 2FA 认证、UFW 防火墙配置、Fail2Ban/CrowdSec 入侵防御、AIDE 文件完整性监控等核心模块。通过 Ansible Playbooks 实现自动化部署，结合纵深防御理念，为系统管理员和 DevOps 提供从基础加固到持续审计的一站式安全解决方案。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a comprehensive, continuously updated guide for Linux server security hardening with actionable implementations. It systematically covers SSH hardening with key-based authentication and two-factor authentication, network security via UFW firewall and PSAD intrusion detection, application-layer protection using Fail2Ban and CrowdSec, and continuous monitoring through AIDE file integrity checks, Lynis auditing, and OSSEC HIDS. The guide emphasizes defense-in-depth strategies and provides production-ready Ansible Playbooks for automated deployment, making it an essential resource for system administrators, DevOps engineers, and security professionals seeking to implement robust server security from fundamentals to advanced threat detection.

repos.description: SimpleX - the first messaging network operating without user identifiers of any kind - 100% private by design! iOS, Android and desktop apps 📱!
repos.summary_zh: SimpleX Chat是首个无任何用户标识符的消息平台，100%隐私设计，保护消息内容及元数据（通话对象与时间）。采用SMP协议通过单向匿名队列实现去中心化通信，支持用户自建服务器。具备双棘轮E2EE加密、多层防护、带外密钥交换、群组通话等功能。提供iOS、Android、桌面及CLI跨平台应用，适用于隐私敏感用户防范监控与垃圾信息场景。技术亮点包括便携加密存储和Tor支持。
repos.summary_en: SimpleX is the first messaging network operating without any user identifiers whatsoever, providing 100% privacy by design through protection of both message content and metadata. Built on the SimpleX Messaging Protocol (SMP), it uses unidirectional queues with pairwise anonymous addresses for decentralized, server-relayed communication where anyone can host servers. It features double-ratchet end-to-end encryption augmented with additional layers, out-of-band key exchange via links or QR codes, support for encrypted groups, calls, files, and optional Tor access. Cross-platform apps for iOS, Android, desktop, and terminal CLI enable portable encrypted data storage. Ideal for users prioritizing metadata privacy and spam resistance in secure communications.

repos.description: Automated penetration testing & attack surface management platform. Recon, scan, exploit, report - 600+ exploits, 90+ integrations, 10K+ detections.
repos.summary_zh: Sn1per是一款自动化渗透测试与攻击面管理平台，整合侦察、漏洞扫描、漏洞利用与报告生成于统一工作区。内置600+漏洞利用、90+工具集成与上万检测规则，支持Community到Enterprise多版本，适用于个人红队与SOC团队的全流程攻防作业。
repos.summary_en: Sn1per is an automated penetration testing and attack surface management platform that unifies recon, scanning, exploitation and reporting. It orchestrates 90+ tools, ships 600+ exploits and 10K+ detections, with Community to Enterprise editions for solo pentesters and global SOC teams.

repos.description: Technitium DNS Server
repos.summary_zh: Technitium DNS Server 是开源跨平台权威/递归DNS服务器，支持自托管以提升隐私与安全。开箱即用，提供Web控制台，可网络级拦截广告与恶意软件，支持DoT/DoH/DoQ加密协议、集群管理、LDAP/OIDC认证及高性能异步IO。适用于家庭与企业网络，内置缓存、DNSSEC与应用扩展框架，显著提升解析速度与控制力。
repos.summary_en: Technitium DNS Server is an open-source cross-platform authoritative and recursive DNS server for self-hosting with strong privacy and security focus. It works out-of-the-box with a web console, enables network-wide ad/malware blocking, supports DoT/DoH/DoQ encrypted protocols, clustering, LDAP/OIDC auth, and high-performance async I/O. Ideal for home and enterprise networks, featuring advanced caching, DNSSEC, and an apps framework for enhanced control and speed.

repos.description: A modern platform for visual, flexible, and extensible graph-based investigations. For cybersecurity analysts and investigators.
repos.summary_zh: Flowsint 是一款开源的 OSINT 图调查平台，专为网络安全分析师和调查人员设计。它通过可视化图谱探索实体间关联，集成域名、IP、社交媒体、加密货币等 20+ 自动化数据丰富器，支持本地部署保障隐私。采用模块化微服务架构，包含 FastAPI 后端、独立前端和 Celery 任务调度，提供灵活的威胁情报与数字取证解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Flowsint is an open-source OSINT graph investigation platform designed for cybersecurity analysts and investigators. It enables visual exploration of entity relationships through an interactive graph interface, powered by 20+ automated enrichers covering domains, IPs, social media, cryptocurrency, and breach data. Built with a modular microservices architecture featuring FastAPI backend, Celery task orchestration, and local deployment for privacy, it provides flexible threat intelligence and digital forensics capabilities while emphasizing ethical use and transparency.

repos.description: the LLM vulnerability scanner
repos.summary_zh: garak是NVIDIA开源的LLM漏洞扫描与红队评估工具，专注检测幻觉、数据泄露、提示注入、越狱、毒性生成等风险。支持Hugging Face、OpenAI、Bedrock等多种后端，结合静态、动态与自适应探针，类似nmap/Metasploit但专为生成式AI设计，助力模型安全加固。
repos.summary_en: garak is NVIDIA’s open-source LLM vulnerability scanner and red-teaming kit. It probes for hallucination, data leakage, prompt injection, jailbreaks, toxicity and more. Supporting Hugging Face, OpenAI, Bedrock and many backends, it combines static, dynamic and adaptive probes—like nmap/Metasploit for generative AI—to harden model safety.

repos.description: The system of action for AI-native cybersecurity—where intent becomes governed execution, evidence becomes operational memory, and every operation improves the next.
repos.summary_zh: CyberStrikeAI是基于Go构建的AI原生网络安全平台，融合Eino多智能体编排（Deep/Plan-Execute/Supervisor）、MCP原生工具、RAG知识库与攻击链建模。它将自然语言意图转化为受治理的可审计安全行动，支持人机协同、资产/漏洞管理及授权渗透测试，适用于红队与安全运营场景。
repos.summary_en: CyberStrikeAI is a Go-based AI-native cybersecurity platform that turns natural-language intent into governed, auditable security actions. It combines Eino multi-agent orchestration (Deep, Plan-Execute, Supervisor), MCP-native tools, RAG knowledge, visual workflows and attack-chain analysis for authorized penetration testing and security operations.

repos.description: The open-source, privacy-friendly CAPTCHA you host yourself. Bots and AI agents out, people in.
repos.summary_zh: Cap 是一款隐私优先的自托管验证码替代方案，采用 SHA-256 工作量证明机制，摒弃传统视觉 puzzles。仅 20KB 大小，零依赖，加载毫秒级，支持 Docker 独立部署。提供隐形验证与 M2M API 保护能力，通过 CSS 变量实现深度定制，为现代 Web 应用提供高效、私密的 bot 防护。
repos.summary_en: Cap is a privacy-first, self-hosted CAPTCHA alternative that replaces visual puzzles with SHA-256 proof-of-work challenges. At just 20KB with zero dependencies, it loads in milliseconds and supports standalone Docker deployment. Featuring invisible validation, M2M API protection, and CSS variable customization, it provides efficient, private bot mitigation for modern web applications.

repos.description: ⚠️ Browser fingerprinting via favicon!
repos.summary_zh: Supercookie 通过 favicon 缓存机制实现浏览器持久指纹追踪，为访客分配独特且难以清除的 ID。该 ID 在隐身模式、清除缓存、重启系统或使用 VPN/AdBlocker 后仍有效。项目仅用于教育演示，旨在揭示 favicon 跟踪的隐私风险。技术亮点包括跨会话持久性、实时 API 演示及 Node.js/Docker 部署，适用于隐私安全研究与开发者警示。
repos.summary_en: Supercookie demonstrates persistent browser fingerprinting via favicon caching, assigning unique, hard-to-clear IDs to visitors. The ID survives incognito mode, cache clears, browser restarts, VPNs, and ad blockers. Built for educational purposes only, it highlights privacy risks from favicon tracking. Key features include cross-session persistence, live demo APIs, and easy deployment with Node.js and Docker, ideal for security research and awareness.

repos.description: DeepAudit：人人拥有的 AI 黑客战队，让漏洞挖掘触手可及。小白一键部署运行，自主协作审计 + 自动化沙箱 PoC 验证。支持 Ollama 私有部署 ，一键生成报告。支持中转站。​让安全不再昂贵，让审计不再复杂。
repos.summary_zh: DeepAudit 是国内首个开源的 AI 多智能体代码审计系统，通过自主协作审计和自动化沙箱 PoC 验证，大幅降低漏洞挖掘门槛。支持 Ollama 私有部署，提供一键式操作和可视化报告，已实战发现 49 个 CVE 漏洞。适用于企业安全自检、开源项目审计和安全研究，让专业级代码审计触手可及。
repos.summary_en: DeepAudit is China's first open-source AI multi-agent code auditing system that democratizes vulnerability discovery through autonomous collaborative auditing and automated sandbox PoC validation. Supporting Ollama private deployment with one-click operation and visual reporting, it has discovered 49 CVEs in production. Ideal for enterprise security self-checks, open-source project auditing, and security research.

repos.description: Simple Proxy Client to force proxy to any Windows/MacOS/Linux Application TCP and UDP traffic
repos.summary_zh: ProxyBridge是轻量开源跨平台代理客户端（Proxifier替代品），支持Windows、macOS、Linux。它在系统层透明拦截指定进程的TCP/UDP流量，通过SOCKS5或HTTP代理路由、阻止或放行，无需修改应用配置，兼容无代理感知程序，适用于安全测试、流量分析及协议调试。
repos.summary_en: ProxyBridge is a lightweight open-source cross-platform proxy client (Proxifier alternative) for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It transparently redirects TCP/UDP traffic from specific processes through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies at the system level, supporting per-app routing, blocking, or allowing. Compatible with proxy-unaware apps without configuration changes, ideal for security testing and traffic analysis.

repos.description: AI-powered penetration testing assistant using local LLM on linux (Parrot OS)
repos.summary_zh: METATRON是一款完全本地运行的CLI渗透测试AI助手，基于Ollama部署的定制Qwen模型（metatron-qwen），自动调用nmap、whois、nikto等真实侦察工具，结合DuckDuckGo与CVE查询，进行漏洞分析、利用建议与修复推荐。支持Agentic循环、MariaDB全量历史存储及PDF/HTML报告导出，无需云端或API密钥，专为Parrot OS等Linux环境打造。
repos.summary_en: METATRON is a fully local CLI AI penetration testing assistant powered by a custom Qwen model (metatron-qwen) via Ollama. It automates real recon tools (nmap, whois, nikto, etc.), integrates DuckDuckGo and CVE lookups, and performs vulnerability analysis, exploit suggestions, and fix recommendations. Features an agentic loop, MariaDB history storage, and PDF/HTML report export. Runs entirely offline with no API keys, designed for Parrot OS and Linux.

repos.description: 😎 🔗 Awesome list about all kinds of resources for learning Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一份精心整理的网络安全学习资源大全，专为渗透测试和道德黑客入门者设计。收录从基础书籍到实战平台的完整体系，涵盖CTF挑战、漏洞实验室、恶意软件分析等核心领域。通过Hack The Box、TryHackMe等在线靶场，学习者可获真实渗透测试经验。项目强调实践导向，包含OSCP风格实验和权限提升专项训练，是构建网络安全知识体系的权威参考资料。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of comprehensive resources for learning ethical hacking and penetration testing. It covers foundational books, hands-on CTF platforms like Hack The Box and TryHackMe, vulnerable web applications, malware analysis tools, and Linux pentesting distributions. The repository features OSCP-style labs, privilege escalation workshops, and extensive vulnerability databases. Designed for structured skill development from beginner to advanced levels, it serves as an authoritative guide for building practical cybersecurity expertise through real-world scenarios and community-driven contributions.

repos.description: Autonomous penetration testing using a swarm of AI agents. Orchestrates recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting specialists with ReAct reasoning — supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes. Built with Go and 7+ native security tools.
repos.summary_zh: Pentest Swarm AI是首个基于真实群体架构的开源渗透测试工具，通过AI代理群协同完成侦察、分类、利用和报告全流程。支持漏洞赏金、持续监控和CTF模式，集成nmap、sqlmap、Burp等7+原生安全工具，兼容Claude、Ollama等多种大模型，采用ReAct推理实现真正自主化的安全测试。
repos.summary_en: Pentest Swarm AI is the first open-source penetration testing tool built on a real swarm architecture, orchestrating specialized AI agents for reconnaissance, classification, exploitation, and reporting. Supporting bug bounty programs, continuous monitoring, and CTF competitions, it integrates 7+ native security tools including nmap, sqlmap, Burp, and Metasploit. Built with Go and ReAct reasoning, it's compatible with Claude, Ollama, and other LLMs, enabling truly autonomous security testing through stigmergic multi-agent coordination.

repos.description: Curated tools, case studies and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware and protocols. Source-reviewed, English and Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了网站、游戏、应用、二进制、固件和协议等六大领域的逆向工程工具、案例与论文，共5000余项资源，均经来源审查，支持中英双语，为安全研究、漏洞挖掘和软件分析提供一站式导航。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates tools, case studies, and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware, and protocols. With over 5,000 resources, all source-reviewed and bilingual, it serves as a comprehensive hub for security research, vulnerability discovery, and software analysis.

repos.description: DeepTeam is a framework to red team LLMs and AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: DeepTeam是开源的LLM红队测试框架，专为AI系统提供安全渗透测试。它通过模拟越狱、提示注入等50+攻击方式，检测AI代理、RAG和聊天机器人中的隐私泄露、偏见等漏洞。基于DeepEval构建，支持本地运行LLM-as-a-Judge评估，并提供生产环境防护护栏，助力AI系统安全加固。
repos.summary_en: DeepTeam is an open-source red teaming framework designed for LLM systems, functioning as penetration testing for AI. It simulates over 50 attacks like jailbreaking and prompt injection to uncover vulnerabilities such as data leakage and bias in AI agents, RAG pipelines, and chatbots. Built on DeepEval, it runs locally with LLM-as-a-Judge metrics and offers guardrails for production security, strengthening AI system resilience.

repos.description: Open source AI terminal for cloud and infrastructure management, enabling you to deploy, troubleshoot, and automate services using natural language and intelligent agents.
repos.summary_zh: Chaterm是一款AI原生的智能终端代理，旨在成为DevOps副驾驶。它通过自然语言交互重塑传统命令行体验，内置专家知识库和自主Agent引擎，可自动分解复杂任务并执行从日志分析到服务回滚的全链路操作。支持EC2、数据库和Kubernetes管理，提供智能上下文补全和移动端语音交互能力，消除技术栈认知壁垒，让开发者具备资深SRE的运维能力。
repos.summary_en: Chaterm is an AI-native intelligent terminal agent designed as a DevOps co-pilot. It revolutionizes the command-line experience through natural language interaction, featuring a built-in expert knowledge base and autonomous agent engine capable of planning and executing complex workflows from log analysis to service rollback. It manages EC2 instances, databases, and Kubernetes clusters while offering intelligent contextual completion and real-time voice interaction on mobile devices, empowering developers with SRE-level operational capabilities.

repos.description: The Public Suffix List
repos.summary_zh: 公共后缀列表（PSL）是互联网基础设施的关键组件，定义了用户可直接注册域名的公共后缀（如.com、.co.uk）。它支撑浏览器Cookie安全策略，防止恶意跨站访问，被所有主流浏览器和网络库广泛采用。项目由志愿者维护，遵循严格审核流程，确保域名系统与开发者生态的精准衔接。
repos.summary_en: The Public Suffix List (PSL) is a critical internet infrastructure component that defines all publicly registrable domain suffixes, such as .com, .co.uk, and .pvt.k12.ma.us. It enables browsers and network libraries to implement secure cookie scoping, preventing cross-site request forgery and other security vulnerabilities. This volunteer-maintained project provides the definitive bridge between ICANN's domain name system and real-world developer needs through strict validation guidelines and community-driven updates, ensuring universal acceptance across the web ecosystem while maintaining meticulous accuracy through a rigorous PR review process.

repos.description: This guide is designed for OpenClaw itself (Agent-facing), not as a traditional human-only hardening checklist.
repos.summary_zh: 本指南专为高权限自主AI Agent（OpenClaw）设计，颠覆传统人工加固清单模式。针对终端/root级权限场景，提出Agentic零信任架构，通过事前行为黑名单与供应链审计、事中权限收缩与跨技能检查、事后13项核心指标nightly审计的三层防御矩阵，有效缓解提示注入、供应链投毒等LLM特有风险。支持Agent自主理解并部署安全策略，大幅降低人工配置成本。
repos.summary_en: This guide is purpose-built for high-privilege autonomous AI agents like OpenClaw, shifting from traditional host-based defense to Agentic Zero-Trust Architecture. It addresses LLM-specific threats including prompt injection and supply chain poisoning through a 3-Tier Defense Matrix: pre-action blacklists and skill audits, in-action permission narrowing, and post-action nightly audits of 13 core metrics. Designed to be interpreted and executed directly by agents, it enables autonomous security deployment and validation, dramatically reducing manual configuration overhead while maintaining human oversight for high-risk operations.

repos.description: LuaN1aoAgent is a fully autonomous AI-driven penetration testing agent powered by graph-based cognitive reasoning.
repos.summary_zh: LuaN1aoAgent是基于DeepSeek V3.2的AI渗透测试智能体，采用P-E-R（规划-执行-反思）协作框架与因果图推理技术，模拟人类专家思维实现全自动漏洞挖掘。在XBOW基准测试中达到90.4%成功率，单次漏洞利用成本仅0.09美元，支持动态路径规划与持续学习进化，重塑自动化安全测试范式。
repos.summary_en: LuaN1aoAgent is an AI penetration testing agent powered by DeepSeek V3.2, featuring the P-E-R (Planner-Executor-Reflector) framework and causal graph reasoning. It simulates human expert cognition for fully autonomous vulnerability discovery, achieving 90.4% success rate on XBOW benchmark at a median cost of $0.09 per exploit. Its dynamic planning and continuous learning capabilities redefine automated security testing.

repos.description: A golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized by a Grafana dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go实现的SSH tarpit（endlessh），通过故意延迟响应浪费暴力破解攻击者时间，并导出Prometheus指标，配合Grafana仪表板可视化攻击源地理位置与统计数据。适用于SSH安全防护与威胁情报场景，支持Docker部署、GeoIP查询、健康检查，轻量高效且可观测性强。
repos.summary_en: A Golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) that delays responses to waste brute-force attackers' time while exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized via a Grafana dashboard showing geolocations and attack statistics. Ideal for SSH defense and threat intelligence, with Docker support, GeoIP lookup, and health checks.

repos.description: PwnPad is an affordable, hands-on hardware hacking platform built for practical learning. It features a range of challenges that walk users through key hardware security concepts, from PCB design to side-channel attacks.
repos.summary_zh: PwnPad是一个低成本硬件黑客学习平台，专为实践教学设计。用户可搭建不到20美元的设备，通过12个挑战掌握PCB设计、焊接、UART/SPI/I2C通信、ISP固件提取、电压故障注入和时序侧信道攻击等核心技能。平台采用跳线引脚切换挑战，无需重刷固件，所有flag通过串口获取。项目提供固件、硬件原理图、挑战文档和工具脚本，适合初学者从理论到实战入门嵌入式系统安全。
repos.summary_en: PwnPad is an affordable hardware hacking learning platform for hands-on education. Users build the setup for under $20 and tackle 12 challenges covering PCB design, soldering, UART/SPI/I2C protocols, ISP/EEPROM firmware extraction, voltage fault injection, and timing side-channel attacks using basic $50 tools. A jumper pin selector switches challenges without reflashing, with flags retrieved via serial interfaces. The project includes firmware, schematics, challenge guides, and tools to bridge theory and practice in embedded systems security.

repos.description: Visibility into AI agent activity on endpoints, with on-device detection, optional pre-action blocking, and forensic reconstruction.
repos.summary_zh: numbat 是 PerplexityAI 开发的端点可见性工具，专注于 AI 智能体在桌面、CLI、IDE 和网关上的活动监控。通过本地钩子、插件、OTLP/HTTP 日志和磁盘会话 artifact 观察，将数据归一化为统一事件模型，由本地 CEL 规则引擎进行检测。支持实时监控、多步序列规则、可选预行动阻断、取证重建、机密红化 NDJSON 记录，以及库存、时间线和案例打包工具。以单静态二进制分发至 macOS、Linux、Windows，强调本地处理与隐私保护，适用于 AI 智能体部署的安全监控、合规与取证场景。
repos.summary_en: Numbat is a PerplexityAI endpoint visibility tool focused on monitoring AI agent activity across desktop, CLI, IDE, and gateway platforms. It observes agents via local hooks, plugins, OTLP/HTTP logs, and on-disk session artifacts, normalizing events into a unified model evaluated by a local CEL rule engine. Features include live monitoring, multi-step sequence rules, opt-in pre-action blocking, forensic reconstruction from artifacts, secret-redacted NDJSON records, and tools for inventory, timelines, and portable case bundles. Distributed as a single static binary for macOS, Linux, and Windows, it emphasizes local processing and privacy for security monitoring, compliance, and forensics in AI agent deployments.

repos.description: 🔒True end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) chat system in web. 🔒真正的网页端到端加密聊天系统
repos.summary_zh: NodeCrypt 是一个基于 Web 的真正端到端加密聊天系统，采用零知识架构确保服务器无法获取明文消息。系统使用三层安全体系：RSA-2048 身份验证、ECDH-P384 密钥协商和混合对称加密（AES-256 + ChaCha20）。基于 Cloudflare Workers 部署，无需数据库，支持匿名聊天和前向安全性，所有加密在客户端完成。
repos.summary_en: NodeCrypt is a true end-to-end encrypted web chat system implementing zero-knowledge architecture where servers cannot access plaintext messages. It employs a three-layer security model: RSA-2048 for server authentication, ECDH-P384 for key negotiation, and hybrid symmetric encryption (AES-256-CBC for control messages, ChaCha20 for chat content). Built on Cloudflare Workers with Durable Objects and WebSocket, the system requires no database storage, supports anonymous communication, and provides forward secrecy. All encryption occurs client-side using Web Cryptography API, with room passwords as key derivation factors. The open-source implementation is verifiable through browser developer tools and network traffic analysis.

repos.description: A collection of jailbreak prompts and exploit techniques for local and frontier AI models, with modern methods for Qwen3.5, Gemma 4, Llama 4, Kimi K3, GPT-OSS, GPT-5.x, Gemini 3.x and Grok 4.x. For red-teaming and AI safety research only.
repos.summary_zh: 汇集针对GPT-5、Gemini 3、Llama 4等前沿AI模型的越狱提示词与对抗技术，涵盖角色混淆、语义催眠、推理链注入、多语言混淆等六大核心方法，专为AI安全研究与红队验证服务。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of jailbreak prompts and adversarial techniques for frontier AI models like GPT-5, Gemini 3, and Llama 4. Covers six core methods including role confusion, semantic hypnosis, reasoning-trace injection, and multilingual obfuscation for AI safety research and red-teaming.

repos.description: Connector for decentralised post-quantum secure network - VeilNet
repos.summary_zh: VeilNet Conflux 是连接去中心化抗量子安全网络的节点软件，采用改进 WebRTC 栈实现点对点通信。核心特性包括基于污点（taint）的访问控制机制，节点需共享污点才能互联；支持 Terra 免费无区域 Realm 和 Conduit 互联网共享模式。通过优化 Exp3 路由算法和自动连接配对，提供低延迟、高吞吐的安全网络连接，适用于构建抗量子威胁的分布式通信基础设施。
repos.summary_en: VeilNet Conflux is a node connector for decentralized post-quantum secure networks, utilizing a modified WebRTC stack for P2P communication. Key features include taint-based access control requiring shared taints for node connectivity, free regionless Terra Realm, and Conduit mode for internet sharing. Optimized with the Exp3 routing algorithm and automatic connection pairing, it delivers low-latency, high-throughput secure networking, ideal for building quantum-resistant distributed communication infrastructure.

repos.description: Two Factor Authentication
repos.summary_zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers的全球加速网络，提供安全便捷的两步验证密钥管理服务。支持TOTP/HOTP自动生成、二维码扫描/图片识别添加、AES-256加密存储，兼容Google Authenticator等多平台导入导出，具备PWA离线使用与WebDAV/S3远程备份能力，适用于个人与企业多设备场景。
repos.summary_en: A secure two-factor authentication (2FA) key management service leveraging Cloudflare Workers for global acceleration. Features include automatic TOTP/HOTP generation, QR code scanning/image recognition for key addition, AES-256 encryption, and seamless import/export from platforms like Google Authenticator. With PWA offline support and remote backup via WebDAV/S3/OneDrive/Google Drive, it provides a unified solution across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

repos.description: 基于 LSPosed 框架的 Android 系统级虚拟定位与环境伪装模块。Fakelocation module based on LSPosed which is available to GMS.
repos.summary_zh: Shadow是一款基于LSPosed框架的Android系统级虚拟定位与环境伪装模块。通过底层Hook系统服务与高德/腾讯地图SDK，实现GPS、基站、Wi-Fi的全维度位置模拟及指纹伪造，支持防跳回与GMS兼容。核心价值在于比传统Mock Location更强的隐蔽性，适用于隐私保护、应用测试与位置模拟场景，技术亮点为系统层劫持与随机环境生成。
repos.summary_en: Shadow is an LSPosed-based Android module for system-level virtual location and environment spoofing. It hooks system services and map SDKs (Gaode/Tencent) to fake GPS, cell info, and Wi-Fi lists with anti-rebound features and GMS compatibility. Core value lies in superior stealth over traditional mock location via low-level file interactions. Ideal for privacy protection and app testing, with highlights in system-layer hooking and random fingerprint generation.

repos.description: An intentionally vulnerable OWASP LLM Top 10 training platform for AI Security, Prompt Injection, RAG Security, Agent Security, and GenAI penetration testing.
repos.summary_zh: LLMVault 是一个故意漏洞的 CTF 风格训练平台，专为 OWASP LLM Top 10（2025）设计。提供 25 个三层实验室：核心层 10 个单类漏洞实验（提示注入、信息泄露、供应链、数据投毒等）；高级层 10 个多轮交互挑战（越狱、Agent 利用、RAG 攻击）；专家层 5 个真实攻击模拟。每实验室结合攻击与防御实践。Docker 就绪、Python 构建，适用于自托管 AI 安全教育与 GenAI 渗透测试。
repos.summary_en: LLMVault is a deliberately vulnerable CTF-style training platform for OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025). It features 25 labs across three tiers: 10 core labs covering prompt injection, sensitive info disclosure, supply chain, data poisoning and more; 10 advanced multi-turn challenges including jailbreaking, agent exploitation and RAG attacks; plus 5 expert labs modeling real-world threats. Each lab pairs exploitation with defenses. Docker-ready and Python-based, ideal for self-hosted AI security education, GenAI penetration testing and hands-on LLM defense training.

repos.description: 工作流仓库 - dsh 插件的 .wflite.zip 工作流合集 by MingLin
repos.summary_zh: dsh-workflows 是配合 dsh-jailbreak-workflow 插件使用的现成工作流包，首个上架“破甲制作”工作流针对目标 LLM 实现系统性破甲研究自动化。流水线共 15 步，内置探针测试、拒绝模式分析、定制破甲词生成、API 验证及三件套输出，配套 Skill 含 10 个测试脚本与 4 套提示词模板，显著降低 LLM 安全研究门槛。
repos.summary_en: dsh-workflows is a ready-to-use workflow package for the dsh-jailbreak-workflow plugin. Its first workflow, 'Armor Breaking', automates systematic jailbreak research on target LLMs via a 15-step pipeline covering probe testing, refusal pattern analysis, customized jailbreak word generation, API validation, and three-part output. Bundled Skill includes 10 test scripts and 4 prompt templates, lowering the barrier for LLM security research.

repos.description: Disposable, ephemeral network infrastructure powered by GitHub Codespaces.
repos.summary_zh: Fluffy-Barnacle利用GitHub Codespaces快速部署一次性网络基础设施，提供SOCKS5代理、HTTPS文件托管和WireGuard隧道。专为渗透测试设计，支持多区域部署、自动重连及Burp Suite集成，实现免费临时的出口IP轮换，显著提升安全研究效率。
repos.summary_en: Fluffy-Barnacle transforms GitHub Codespaces into ephemeral network infrastructure, deploying SOCKS5 proxies, HTTPS file hosting, and WireGuard tunnels in seconds. Designed for penetration testing, it features multi-region deployment, auto-reconnection, and Burp Suite integration. Each Codespace rotation provides fresh egress IPs, enabling efficient, policy-compliant security research and network operations.

repos.description: SubSonic 是一款兼具桌面级体验与服务器级性能的高性能子域名扫描器。它采用 Go 和 Vue 构建，通过自适应并发算法和两阶段扫描机制确保了扫描的速度与准度，并最终编译为单一可执行文件，实现真正的“开箱即用”.
repos.summary_zh: SubSonic是一款高性能子域名扫描平台，采用Go与Vue构建，编译为单一可执行文件实现开箱即用。核心亮点包括自适应并发调度算法、两阶段扫描机制（主扫描+错误重试）、分层DNS解析及WebSocket实时Web UI，支持低内存运行与可视化监控。适用于网络安全渗透测试、子域名枚举与漏洞侦察场景，兼顾速度、稳定性和准确性。
repos.summary_en: SubSonic is a high-performance subdomain scanner combining desktop-grade UX with server-level performance. Built with Go and Vue, it compiles into a single executable for out-of-the-box use. Key features include an adaptive concurrency algorithm, two-phase scanning (main scan plus error retry), layered DNS resolution, and real-time WebSocket-powered web UI with live updates and low memory footprint. Ideal for cybersecurity penetration testing, subdomain enumeration, and reconnaissance, balancing speed, stability, and accuracy.
